listing.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder (nxport)
listing.summary: Build the nxport version of Super Mario Bros. Wonder from your own extracted Switch files. The project reports macOS testing with some button prompts appearing as question marks. The iOS build target is available, but its gameplay and the tested game version remain unconfirmed.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Supply your own extracted ExeFS, RomFS and Logo. The project does not identify a confirmed version, region or title ID.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build nxport-builder from source, select Super Mario Bros. Wonder and choose Mac or iOS to generate a local app or IPA. You manage preparation and updates. There is no ready-made package.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The builder targets Apple silicon. Windows and Linux players are unconfirmed.
